Defense Industry Security Program

Comprehensive DISP consulting for all security levels—from entry-level to Top Secret

DISP Entry Level

Basic security for unclassified defense information

Service Deliverables:

• Security plan development
• Personnel security clearances
• Physical security assessment
• Information security controls
• Annual compliance reporting

Timeline:

3-6 months

Best for

Entry-level defense contractors

Enquire now

DISP Level 1

The factors of implementation are increased

Service Deliverables:

• Everything in Entry Level
• Additional Questioning in Gap Analysis
• Further Provisions in Governance Documentation
• Additional Cyber Security Policies
• E8 Maturity Level Increased (Cyber)

Timeline:

6-8 months

Best for

Level 1 defense contractors

Enquire now

DISP Level 2

It will grant access to SECRET information.

Service Deliverables:

• Everything in Entry Level, Level 1
• Adjust Deliverables To: Level 2 Requirements
• Mandatory Site Inspection



 

Timeline:

12 months+

Best for

Level 2 defense contractors

Enquire now

DISP Level 3

Requires significant expansion of project scope.

Service Deliverables:

• Everything in Entry Level, Level 1, Level 2
• Adjust Deliverables To: Level 3 Requirements
• Custom Package
• For organisations involved in the most classified technologies, operations and defence works.

Timeline:

12 months+

Best for

Level 2 defense contractors

Enquire now
